This is almost certainly a template/formula artifact rather than a genuine reported average: the C11 GPA-distribution table immediately above (score ranges 4.0 down to below 1.0) has every individual percent cell left completely empty, and its own 'Totals should = 100%' row also auto-computes to '0.00%' -- consistent with an average-of-empty-range formula defaulting to 0 and inheriting the percent-format of the cell above it, not with Cornell reporting an actual 0.00 average GPA (which would be nonsensical). Per brief instructions this metric's own guidance says to extract only the printed value and not infer/clamp, so recorded literally as present/0 rather than reclassified as blank -- but flagged ambiguous because the printed content strongly suggests no real data was submitted. Alternate candidate reading: status 'blank' (institution provided no GPA data at all, and '0.00%' is a non-data artifact).
